item.title: Version 2.6.4
item.description:
What's New in 2.6.4

⚙️ Improvements

  • A Start button where you actually look for it — When sharing is off, the Host window now offers Start sharing right under the status line, instead of hiding it in the menu bar. The status line also says "Not sharing" rather than "Offline", because your Mac is still reachable — it simply isn’t sharing its screen right now.

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Fixed taking your screen back locking your devices out — Pressing Esc twice during a session — the shortcut the Host itself suggests — ended sharing for good. Your phone kept listing this Mac as online, but every attempt to connect failed, and the only way back was quitting and reopening Remio Host. Taking your screen back now just ends the session: the Mac is ready to accept a connection again moments later, without anyone touching it.
